lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy6Fe20Co2 (reduced formula Dy3Fe10Co) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 194), with 28 atoms per unit cell distributed over 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: Co and Fe centers each show 12 geometric neighbors (Co–Fe, Fe–Fe, and Fe–Dy contacts), while Dy centers show 12 Fe neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component containing all 28 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Fe-centered 12-vertex polyhedra.
